description: This PHP source file defines the class DropDownTree, which extends MBPackageTree, and is used to represent a tree structure of dropdown options related to package management in the SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for constructing the tree and retrieving its name.

classes.name: DropDownTree
classes.description: A class that represents a tree structure for dropdown packages, extending MBPackageTree, and initialized with nodes from DropDownBrowser.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DropDownTree object, sets up the tree structure, and populates it using nodes from DropDownBrowser.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the localized name for this tree section, specifically 'Packages'.
